product.description: Introducing Stage Right™ by Monoprice STARQUAD XLR Microphone Cables. These are Pro-Grade, balanced microphone cables, commonly used to carry low-level signals. Microphones produce very low level signal feeds, which are easily susceptible to magnetic interference. Microphone outputs must be amplified and when a microphone feed is amplified, any interference will also be amplified.Stage Right STARQUAD XLR Microphone Cables' four cores are very tightly twisted with each other and rotate over a relatively short length, very similar to what is found in an Ethernet cable. This arrangement results in a greatly improved rejection of electromagnetic interference, compared to standard two-core balanced mic cables.Because of the nature of taking a performance on tour, the layout of the venue and the stage is widely unknown. Using Stage Right STARQUAD XLR Microphone Cables will ensure a noise-free performance, no matter where the road takes you.
